## About this tool

SEO Wins (seowins.net) checks a single page the way a search engine reads it: the raw HTML, without running JavaScript. It looks at titles and descriptions, headings, content depth, links, images, structured data, technical signals such as status codes, redirects, robots.txt and sitemaps, and how easy the page is for AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity to quote.

Every problem comes with a plain explanation of how to fix it, sorted so the issues that hurt rankings most are at the top. Add a target keyword to see where it is missing, then download a branded PDF report to share with a client or your team.

## How to use it

- Paste the full address of the page you want to check.

- Optionally add the keyword you want that page to rank for.

- Work through the Issues tab from the top; critical items first.

- Download the PDF report, or ask the AI assistant how to fix a specific issue.

# About SEO Wins

Free SEO and AI search tools for site owners, marketers and agencies.

SEO Wins (seowins.net) started from a simple idea: the checks most people need to improve a website's search visibility should be quick, clear and free. Paste a URL, see what is holding the page back, and get a plain explanation of how to fix it.

Search is changing. People now get answers from Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI assistants as well as classic results. Alongside traditional technical and on-page SEO, every SEOWins audit checks how easily AI answer engines can read, trust and quote your content.

## What you can do here

- Audit any page and download a white-label PDF report.

- Check links, redirects, status codes and security headers.

- Research keywords from real Google searches and plan content with AI briefs.

- Generate schema markup, test robots.txt rules and preview search snippets.

## How the tools work

SEOWins fetches only the public pages you ask it to check, reads the HTML the way a crawler does and analyses it in your browser. AI features are powered by large language models and can make mistakes, so check important facts before acting on them.

Questions or suggestions? Email hello@seowins.net .

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: 24 October 2026

This policy explains what happens to information when you use seowins.net. SEOWins does not offer accounts and does not ask for your name, email address or payment details.

## URLs and domains you check

When you run a tool, the address you enter is sent to our server, which fetches that public page (and files such as robots.txt or DNS records) on your behalf. The results are returned to your browser and analysed there. We do not store the URLs you check or the results.

## AI features

The AI Content Brief, AI Assistant, rewrite and schema tools send your request, and any audit summary you choose to share, to our AI provider, Groq, to generate an answer. Do not include personal or confidential information in AI requests. To prevent abuse, we keep a short-lived count of AI requests per IP address in memory; it is not stored permanently.

## Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand how many people visit and which tools they use. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects information such as pages viewed, approximate location, device and browser. We remove the URLs and keywords you enter from the page addresses sent to Google Analytics. You can block analytics with your browser settings, an ad blocker or Google's opt-out browser add-on.

## Storage in your browser

Your theme choice and any PDF report branding you enter are saved in your browser's local storage so they are remembered next time. They never leave your device, and you can clear them at any time through your browser settings.

## Hosting

The site is hosted on Vercel, which processes standard request information such as IP addresses to deliver and secure the service.

## Contact

For privacy questions, email hello@seowins.net .
